<title>Kitesurfing | New Spirit Dakhla</title>
  <meta name="description" content="New Spirit Dakhla is a modern hotel designed for kitesurfers and wing foilers seeking reliable wind, flat water, and relaxed comfort. Located directly at the Dakhla Lagoon, it offers immediate access to one of the world’s best kite and wingfoil spots. Comfortable bungalows, a great restaurant, pool and pool bar create the perfect balance between time on the water and recovery. Ideal for beginners, advanced riders, kite camps, and extended stays in Morocco."/>

class="font_3 wixui-rich-text__text">Kitesurfing course for kids</h3></div><!--/$--><!--$--><div id="comp-mmjcijpq" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mmjcijpq wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">For children under 14, we offer private lessons only &ndash; ensuring maximum safety and the best possible learning experience. The instructor focuses entirely on the child and can adapt the pace and exercises to their individual needs. This keeps motivation, concentration, and fun high &ndash; and progress often comes naturally.</p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">Shorter lesson units and highly visual teaching methods make the training especially suitable for children. During the practical part, the focus is always on safety and enjoyment, creating a positive and encouraging learning environment.</p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">The Kids course is private instruction, equipment included. The content, level of detail, teaching method and pace are adapted to your child:<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
&nbsp;</p>
<ul class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">Equipment knowledge and setup/pack-down</p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">Safety training on land and in the water</p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">Flying exercises with a trainer kite</p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">Launching the kite in the water</p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">Body drags</p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">Water start with the board</p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">First meters riding on a crosswind course</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">Choose between our 4-hour and 6-hour kids&rsquo; courses:</p></div><!--/$--></div><!--/$--><!--$--><div id="comp-mmjdeq47" role="" class="HFEOE3 NaeT1r comp-mmjdeq47-container comp-mmjdeq47 wixui-box" dir="ltr"><div aria-hidden="true" class="jdJeEr NYfD3h inner-box wixui-box"></div><!--$--><div id="comp-mmjcijq93" role="" class="HFEOE3 NaeT1r comp-mmjcijq93-container comp-mmjcijq93 wixui-box" dir="ltr"><div aria-hidden="true" class="jdJeEr NYfD3h inner-box wixui-box"></div><!--$--><div id="comp-mmjcijqc" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mmjcijqc wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h3 class="font_3 wixui-rich-text__text">4h kids Course (383&euro;)</h3></div><!--/$--><!--$--><div id="comp-mmjcijqg" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mmjcijqg wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">This option is ideal for children who pick up new movements quickly and already have a good feeling for wind, balance, or board control.</p></div><!--/$--><!--$--><div id="comp-mmjcijqi3" class="comp-mmjcijqi3" data-semantic-classname="button"><a data-testid="linkElement" href="https://kbc.kitehub.eu/en/new-spirit-dakhla/booking?services=508" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener" class="StylableButton2545352419__root style-mmjcijqk12__root wixui-button StylableButton2545352419__link" aria-label="Book"><span class="StylableButton2545352419__container"><span class="StylableButton2545352419__label wixui-button__label" data-testid="stylablebutton-label">Book</span><span class="StylableButton2545352419__icon wixui-button__icon" aria-hidden="true" data-testid="stylablebutton-icon"><span>

PO9MfV comp-miq0cg2q5 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text">Wind in Dakhla</h2></div><!--/$--><!--$--><div id="comp-miq0cg2t" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-miq0cg2t wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">Dakhla is one of the world&rsquo;s most wind-reliable regions with powerful wind across the lagoon nearly all year round.</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">The long peninsula creates a natural wind funnel that accelerates the steady trade winds.&nbsp;The cool Canary Current adds a strong thermal effect, reinforcing the wind almost daily.</p></div><!--/$--></div><!--/$--></div></div><!--/$--></div></section><!--/$--><!--$--><section id="comp-miq1luzo" tabindex="-1" data-block-level-container="Section" _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-miq0csd2 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">The spot is tide-dependent and offers a different experience at every water At high tide, the shallow, calm water in front of the center is ideal for beginners.</p>

<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">&nbsp;</p>
